text_block_list.text:
During training, Grass Wonder succumbed to 
the heat and started feeling sick...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's not a problem. I think I'll 
feel better once I cool off a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for interrupting your 
training...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If only my body could easily accept that 
summer is just meant to be hot.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The cold doesn't bother me, but 
this muggy humidity is just unbearable...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If only there were a way to manage it 
skillfully...
choice_data_list:
Clear your mind and even fire will feel 
cool!

Let's use traditional ways to beat the 
heat!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That's... a famous historical idiom, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If you clear all stray thoughts from your 
mind, even fire will feel cool...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see. That might just be the exact 
mindset I need right now.
choice_data_list: Let's see who can focus better!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a challenge...? You know very well 
that I can never back down when phrased 
like that♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Understood, challenge accepted. I won't 
lose to you, Trainer~♪

Though she fell slightly out of shape, she 
seemed to learn how to endure the summer 
heat.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of summer, things that come to 
mind are... paper fans, wind chimes, 
watermelon, and uchimizu, I suppose."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just saying those words makes me 
feel cooler. So Trainer, what are you 
going to do?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However... I do not dislike it♪ Well then, 
shall we get ready at once?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Searching for a 'cool breeze' with 
Trainer... Fufu, I'm looking forward to 
it♪

Though she fell slightly out of shape, she 
seemed to learn how to make the most of 
summer.
